subject: Re: PII handling for prompts/outputs - confirmation and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-03-15T15:12:00Z
Subject: PII handling for prompts/outputs - confirmation and next steps

Hi Samantha/Tom -

Thanks again for the call today - helpful to understand Acme Health's integration pattern and sensitive data concerns. Per our discussion, here's a short recap and a few specific asks so we can get the right controls documented for procurement/legal. Please confirm the points below or flag anything I've misunderstood.

Call recap / asks:
- Use case: embedding/search + LLM summarization for patient-facing notes (PHI scope).
- Primary questions for you to confirm:
  1) Will you be sending PHI in prompts or expecting PHI in outputs? (we assume yes based on the demo)
  2) Data residency requirement: do you need EU-only or US-only processing/storage?
  3) Retention policy: maximum retention for prompts/outputs and for request logs?
  4) Encryption/KMS: do you require customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key)?
  5) Auditability: what level of audit/log access is required (SIEM integration, Syslog, S3 exports)?

What I can confirm from the call and our standard Hosted behavior (we'll follow up with exact language for the DPA/DPSA):
- Hosted API (default): prompts and model outputs can be retained by Redwood for a limited period for monitoring, abuse detection, and quality (see questions below for exact durations).
- Dedicated / Private options: offer stronger isolation and can be configured to meet stricter retention/residency/KMS requirements (details to follow).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the answers to the 5 bullet questions above.
2) I've attached Acme's security questionnaire stub and a short PII summary template - please return the completed questionnaire and we'll route to Security/Legal.
3) If helpful, we'll schedule a short technical call (30m) with Neha (security/inference) and Marissa (solutions) to lock down the retention and residency settings.

Thanks -
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference

Attachments: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_20270315.pdf, PII_Summary_AcmeHealth.docx

Rishi - thanks for the summary and for sending the questionnaire. Quick answers below and attaching our completed security questionnaire (see attachment).

Quick answers:
- We will be sending PHI in prompts (patient names, dates of service, limited identifiers) and expect PHI can appear in outputs.
- Data residency: US-only for production datasets; dev/staging can be US or EU depending on environment labeling.
- Retention: target is 90 days max for any retained prompts/outputs; logs can be retained longer for audit but we'd like controls.
- KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys if possible (enterprise option).
- Auditability: we need SIEM-friendly logs (syslog/S3 export) and access to request-level audit logs for 1 year.

We attached the completed security questionnaire and asked Legal to review DPA language. Let us know if these answers change the recommended deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated/Private). Happy to take the technical call - Tom and I can join.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director of IT Security, Acme Health
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: PII handling for prompts/outputs - confirmation and next steps

Hi all - thanks for the detail, Samantha. Below are concise, actionable answers you can share with Legal/Procurement; happy to jump on the technical call to walk a demo of the controls.

Answers (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private):
1) Are prompts/outputs stored?
   - Hosted (default): Redwood retains prompts and model outputs for up to 30 days by default for abuse detection, quality, and troubleshooting. We offer an Enterprise contract option to disable storage of prompts/outputs for customer data (no retention) or to set a custom retention window (e.g., 90 days) if required by the DPA.
   - Dedicated: Data processed in the Dedicated pool can be configured so that persistent storage of prompts/outputs is disabled; if storage is enabled for logs/metrics, retention windows are configurable via the tenant settings (we can set 90 days).
   - Private (VPC/on-prem): Customer-managed; Redwood control plane can be restricted from storing payloads. Data residency and retention are entirely under customer control.

2) Where is data stored / residency options?
   - Hosted: we offer region-selection for Hosted API (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1). Production data can be restricted to US regions (we recommend us-east-1 for Acme).
   - Dedicated/Private: customers can choose region and/or on-prem options to meet US-only requirements.

3) Retention durations (prompts/outputs, request logs, audit logs):
   - Prompts/outputs (Hosted default): 30 days. Enterprise/DPA: configurable to customer requirement (can be set to 0/disabled or 90 days as requested).
   - Request metadata/operational logs: default 365 days for billing, support, and security auditing.
   - Audit/export: we can provide S3 export or syslog forwarding for request-level logs; retention on the exported side is managed by the customer (we can stream to your SIEM/s3 continuously).

4) Encryption / KMS / access controls:
   - In transit: TLS 1.2+ for all API traffic.
   - At rest: AES-256.
   - Hosted: we use our managed keys by default; Enterprise add-on supports customer-managed keys (CMK) via KMS integration for Hosted and Dedicated.
   - Dedicated/Private: support for BYOK (bring-your-own-key) and HSM integrations is available for contractual agreements.

5) Redaction and PII masking:
   - We do not automatically redact PII by default.
   - Options: we can implement a pre-processing step (on the client or via a Redwood pipeline) to mask or remove PII before it's sent to the model, or we can deploy a tenant-side transform in Dedicated/Private setups. We'll scope the best approach in the technical call.

6) Auditability / SIEM integration:
   - We support streaming logs to S3, syslog, or a SIEM connector. Request-level audit logs can be exported on a rolling basis. We can also provide a one-year retention export (as requested) by pushing logs to your S3 bucket.

Recommended next steps:
- For Acme's stated requirements (US-only + 90-day retention + CMK + 1yr accessible audit logs), we recommend Dedicated deployment or Hosted with Enterprise contract that explicitly sets retention to 90 days and enables CMK.
- I'll upload our SOC 2 Type II report and standard DPA/DPSA templates to the shared Drive link; Legal can redline.
- Let's schedule a 30m technical call this week to confirm S3/syslog export details and KMS key exchange flow.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference
